title: verbascum × godronii subsp. lamottei
intro: Verbascum × godronii subsp. lamottei, commonly known as the bi-coloured mullein, is a plant species within the mullein genus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include offering relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of this plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe coughs, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum × godronii subsp. lamottei include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
